description:
Full-text search across your entire library — documents, highlights, and page content.

This searches the actual text content of your PDFs (every page), highlight text/comments,
and document metadata (title, author, keywords). Results are ranked by relevance with
text snippets showing where matches were found.

Supports natural language queries and websearch syntax:
- Simple: "machine learning"
- Exact phrase: '"neural network"'
- OR: "neural OR deep"
- Exclude: "learning -supervised"

Each result includes match_type ('content', 'highlight', or 'metadata'),
the page number where the match was found, and a snippet with **bold** markers
around matching terms.

params.description: Parameters for full-text search across all document content.

document_id.description: Limit search to a specific document UUID

query.description: Search query. Supports natural language and websearch syntax (e.g. 'machine learning', '"exact phrase"', 'neural OR deep')

scope.description: Search scope: 'all' (default), 'content' (page text only), 'highlights' (highlights only), or 'metadata' (title/author/keywords only)

shelf_id.description: Limit search to documents on a specific shelf UUID

name: highlyt_search
title: Full-Text Library Search
